description: inspire.gv.at is an open data portal listed in inspire.gv.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesministerium für Landwirtschaft, Regionen und Tourismus (BMLRT). Geo Data Portal Austria. Coverage: Austria. The European data portal lists 2,050 datasets from this catalogue. A multilingual title search (26 languages, transport, energy, water, digital and hazard words) found 245 datasets about infrastructure or natural hazards, catalogued as 33 records (collections of three or more datasets from one publisher or service host, and single datasets); the rest are outside the scope of this catalogue. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-bmlfuw-at.
